proposed_title: Exterior Hand Wash & Wax for Sedans, SUVs & Trucks in Orlando – Up to 20% Off

proposed_meta_description: Professional exterior hand wash & wax for sedans ($76), SUVs ($92/$108) in Orlando. Includes wheel cleaning, windows & protective wax. Book today!
proposed_h1: Professional Car Wash and Wax Service in Orlando
proposed_highlights: Complete exterior hand wash with premium protective wax – keeps your vehicle shining and protected
Three package options: Sedans/Coupes ($76), Small SUVs/Trucks ($92), Large SUVs/Vans ($108)
Includes full wheel & tire cleaning, all exterior windows, and hand-applied wax finish
Servicing Orlando drivers since 1999 – trusted by customers who say 'My car looks like new!'
[Example — verify with merchant:] Service takes approximately 60–90 minutes; drop-off or wait on-site in comfortable lounge
[Example — verify with merchant:] Conveniently located in central Orlando – easy access from I-4 and downtown
Appointment required – book after purchase using merchant contact info on your voucher (180-day expiry)
pricing_framing: CRITICAL: The competitor research failed catastrophically—all collected pricing is for human body waxing ($30–$60 range), not auto detailing, making market comparison impossible. Do NOT claim "X% below competitor average." Instead, frame value around: (1) the established merchant credibility (since 1999), (2) the 4.88★ rating with positive customer quotes, and (3) the transparent tiered pricing structure. Most importantly, ADD original/regular pricing for each package to validate the "Up To 20% Off" claim—without this baseline, customers cannot verify they're getting a deal. If original prices are unavailable, either remove the discount claim or soften to "Special offer pricing" to maintain trust.
executive_summary: The page scores 5.8/10 overall. The #1 conversion killer is the severe trust mismatch: only 1 purchase despite a 4.88★ rating from 24 reviews, creating buyer skepticism about deal legitimacy. The second critical issue is missing original pricing—the "Up To 20% Off" claim cannot be verified. Adding transparent pricing context, addressing the low sold count with a freshness badge, and filling the 7 identified content gaps (no address, hours, or service duration) could lift conversion by 20–30%.
